title: Elysian Band — Statement
subtitle: The Elysian Cut™ set full circle — an elongated light that never closes.

stone.origin: Natural. Full eternity. Bez Ambar proprietary elongated cut.

description: The Elysian Cut™ — Bez Ambar's own elongated form, sitting between an oval and a baguette and cut to catch light differently than either — set full circle in eighteen-karat white gold. At this statement scale each stone carries real presence, the elongated facets stretching the light into long flashes as the hand turns. Full eternity, the circle of light closed without interruption. A piece meant to be seen and understood as a single decision. A halfway version is available.
